name: Change Credential
summary: Adversaries may modify software and device credentials to prevent operator and responder access. Depending on the device, the modification or addition of this password could prevent any device configuration actions from being accomplished and may require a factory reset or replacement of hardware. These credentials are often built-in features provided by the device vendors as a means to restrict access to management interfaces. An adversary with…

analytics.name: Analytic 1903
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol commands changing device-level credentials or access codes from a source not in the approved security administration list, where the device subsequently rejects connections from legitimate control system components. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect.
